meetings.comment: 2022 Cincinnati Mayor and Council Inaugural Ceremony/City Council Session

items.t: Appointment of Jan-Michele Lemon Kearney as Vice Mayor
items.sm: Appoints Councilmember Jan-Michele Lemon Kearney as Vice Mayor of the City, effective January 4, 2022, under Article III, Section 3 of the City Charter.

items.t: Appointment of five City Council committee chairs by the Mayor
items.sm: Appoints Greg Landsman, Reggie Harris, Meeka Owens, Scotty Johnson and Jan-Michele Kearney to chair the Budget and Finance, Equitable Growth and Housing, Climate, Environment and Infrastructure, Public Safety and Governance, and Healthy Neighborhoods committees.

items.t: Appoint Councilmembers to committees and set meeting times for the 2022-2024 term
items.sm: Asks Council to appoint Councilmembers to five committees for the 2022-2024 term and to set their meeting days and times, with Week A beginning January 10, 2022, and Week B beginning January 17, 2022.

items.t: Name Victoria Parks as President Pro Tem for the 2022-2024 term
items.sm: Asks Council to name Councilmember Victoria Parks as President Pro Tem for the 2022-2024 term of the Cincinnati City Council.

items.t: Adopt the previous Council's Rules with changes to committee structure and appointments
items.sm: Asks Council to adopt the prior Council's rules, last amended September 27, 2017, with revised Section 10.1 on committee appointments and a new Section 10.2 list of five standing committees.

items.t: Appoint Melissa Autry as Clerk of Council
items.sm: Asks Council to appoint Melissa Autry as Clerk of Council for a term beginning January 4, 2022.

items.t: Successor Designation Certificates Received for 2022-2024 Council Term

items.sm: Reports on a new liquor permit application for Superior Sandman Holdings Inc, doing business as Voodoo Brewery, at 120 E 8th Street, with no objections.

items.t: Report on a liquor permit application for Wildweed LLC at 1301 Walnut Street
items.sm: Reports on a new liquor permit application for Wildweed LLC at 1301 Walnut Street, with no objections.

items.t: Authorize a $55,000 grant for suicide, overdose and childhood trauma prevention assistance
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to apply for, accept and appropriate a $55,000 grant from the National Association of County and City Health Officials to help the Cincinnati Health Department build prevention capacity.

items.t: Authorize a $126,638 grant for COVID-19 prevention in confinement living facilities
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to apply for, accept and appropriate a subgrant of up to $126,638 from the Ohio Department of Health to prevent, detect and mitigate COVID-19 in high-risk confinement living facilities.

items.t: Authorize a $15,000 grant for the Health Equity local conversation project
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to apply for, accept and appropriate a grant of up to $15,000 from the Ohio Commission on Minority Health for the Local Conversation - Health Equity: From Input to Action - Round 3 project.

items.t: Authorize a $24,744.71 payment to Arrowhead Scientific, Inc. for Police Department supplies
items.sm: Authorizes a $24,744.71 moral obligation payment to Arrowhead Scientific, Inc. for supplies received by the Cincinnati Police Department Firearm Intervention Response Support Team at the start of fiscal year 2023.

items.t: Authorize acceptance of a $350,000 state grant for Ault Park trails and playground
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to accept and appropriate up to $350,000 from the Ohio Department of Natural Resources to renovate the trail system and refurbish the playground at Ault Park.

items.action: Referred to Public Safety & Governance Committee
items.t: Modify Municipal Code chapters to streamline the City's process for conveying easements
items.sm: Amends Chapters 119, 331 and 1101 of the Cincinnati Municipal Code to improve the efficiency and transparency of the City's process for conveying easements in City-owned real property.

items.t: Oath of Office for Councilmember-Appointee Seth Walsh
items.sm: Administration of oath of office for newly appointed Councilmember Seth Walsh for term ending 2024.

items.t: Successor Designation Certificate received for Councilmember Seth Walsh
items.sm: Reports receipt of successor designation certificate for Councilmember Seth Walsh.

items.t: Authorize a grant of up to $34,560 from the Seasongood Foundation for an Internship Program
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to apply for, accept and appropriate a grant of up to $34,560 from the Murray & Agnes Seasongood Good Government Foundation to administer an Internship Program.

items.t: Authorize a $1,650,000 subgrant for COVID-19 prevention in congregate living facilities
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to apply for, accept and appropriate a subgrant of up to $1,650,000 from the Ohio Department of Health to prevent, detect and mitigate COVID-19 in high-risk congregate living facilities.

items.t: Authorize a $75,000 subgrant for a Hepatitis C disease intervention specialist
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to accept and appropriate a $75,000 subgrant from the Ohio Association of Community Health Centers to reimburse a Cincinnati Health Department position serving Hepatitis C patients.

items.t: Authorize accepting a $500 donation from the Clifton Area Neighborhood Council
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to accept and appropriate a $500 donation from the Clifton Area Neighborhood Council for a community holiday season event and to deposit it into Fund 319.

items.t: Authorize accepting donated skateboards for the Clifton Recreation Center
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to accept an in-kind donation of skateboards and safety equipment valued at up to $600 from Blacklist Boardshop for a skateboard instruction program at the Clifton Recreation Center.

items.t: Authorize transfers within the General Fund and the Municipal Motor Vehicle License Tax Fund
items.sm: Authorizes transferring $324,600 within the General Fund to realign funds for City departments and $67,400 within the Municipal Motor Vehicle License Tax Fund for human resources centralization efforts.

items.t: Establish an office budget for Councilmember Seth Walsh and transfer $70,052 from Councilmember Landsman
items.sm: Establishes department number 015 for newly appointed Councilmember Seth Walsh and transfers $67,391 in personnel funds and $2,661 in contractual funds from Councilmember Greg Landsman's office budget.

items.t: Modify the Deputy City Manager classification to establish the Chief of Staff position
items.sm: Modifies the classification title and salary range schedule for the Deputy City Manager position by amending Section 032 of Division 5 of the Cincinnati Municipal Code to establish the Chief of Staff classification.

items.t: Establish an Aquatics Bonus Plan and a new Lifeguard salary range
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to establish an Aquatics Bonus Plan to recruit and retain Cincinnati Recreation Commission aquatics employees and modifies the salary range schedule for the Lifeguard classification.

items.t: Authorize a Fifth Amendment to the Warren County Water Area Contract
items.sm: Authorizes the City Manager to execute a Fifth Amendment to the Warren County Water Area Contract with the Board of County Commissioners of Warren County, Ohio, modifying the area the City serves.

items.t: Request that the Administration prioritize equity and climate goals in infrastructure grant applications
items.sm: Asks the Administration to apply policy priorities on connectivity, green infrastructure, workforce development, transit and Justice40 climate equity when seeking funds under the Infrastructure Investment & Jobs Act and the Inflation Reduction Act.

items.t: Authorize the redevelopment of 4924 Winton Road as an office and indoor storage facility
items.sm: Authorizes redevelopment of 4924 Winton Road in Spring Grove Village and Winton Hills as an office and storage facility, notwithstanding single-family, hillside overlay and other zoning limitations, including for a three-bay garage addition.
